title: Rezoning map change for 100 Queens Boulevard, Queens
summary: This application would amend the zoning map in Queens Community District 6 to change an R7-1 district to R9X and adjust related commercial overlay districts near 100 Queens Boulevard. It would also eliminate certain existing C1-2 commercial overlay districts within the R4B and R7-1 zones. The change affects an area in Council District 29.
